title: Kernel filtration for supplied quotient presentations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring in universe $u$, $M$ an object of $\mathrm{ModuleCat}^{v}(R)$, and $E$ a linearly ordered type in universe $w$ whose strict order is well founded. Let $F_e\subseteq M$ be monotone and exhaustive, meaning that each element of $M$ belongs to some $F_e$. Set $U_e=\sup_{i<e}F_i$ and $Q_e=F_e/(U_e\cap F_e)$ [def-weil-pbc-quotient-module]. For each $e$ let $P(e)$ be a supplied projective resolution of $Q_e$ in $\mathrm{ModuleCat}^{v}(R)$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. There exists a short exact complex $S$ in that category with $S_3=M$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], with $S_2$ categorically projective (maps from it lift through every epimorphism in this category), and a monotone exhaustive filtration $G_e\subseteq S_1$ indexed by the same $E$. For every $e$, the quotient $G_e/(\sup_{i<e}G_i\cap G_e)$ is either a zero object or is isomorphic in this category to $\ker(P(e)_0\to Q_e)$. No dimension bound, induction hypothesis, universe relation, or enough-projectives assumption is used.

proof.text: Apply the partial-sum and kernel-projection construction to obtain S and H. Define the kernel filtration G_e as the inverse image of H_e along S.f. Monotonicity follows from Submodule.comap_mono; exhaustion follows by applying the covering property of H to S.f(x).

For an inactive stage the predecessor submodule inside G_e is top, so the quotient is a subsingleton and hence a zero ModuleCat object. At an active stage identify the predecessor submodule with the kernel of the supplied surjective projection q_e using Submodule.quotEquivOfEq, then apply LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective and LinearEquiv.toModuleIso.

theorem exists_projective_presentation_kernel_filtration
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{v} R)
    {E : Type w} [LinearOrder E] [IsWellOrder E (· < ·)]
    (F : E → Submodule R M) (hF : Monotone F)
    (hcover : ∀ x : M, ∃ e : E, x ∈ F e)
    (P : ∀ e : E, ProjectiveResolution
      (ModuleCat.of R ((F e) ⧸
        ((⨆ i : {j : E // j < e}, F i.val).comap (F e).subtype)))) :
    ∃ S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R), S.X₃ = M ∧ S.ShortExact ∧
      Projective S.X₂ ∧ ∃ G : E → Submodule R S.X₁,
        Monotone G ∧ (∀ x : S.X₁, ∃ e : E, x ∈ G e) ∧
        ∀ e : E,
          IsZero (ModuleCat.of R ((G e) ⧸
            ((⨆ i : {j : E // j < e}, G i.val).comap (G e).subtype))) ∨
          Nonempty (ModuleCat.of R ((G e) ⧸
            ((⨆ i : {j : E // j < e}, G i.val).comap (G e).subtype)) ≅
              kernel ((P e).π.f 0))
